events.notes: Warsh's press conference was widely read as dovish (declined to celebrate a soft inflation print, gave vague answers). But 3 hawkish dissents (most in nearly a decade) plus his hawkish prepared remarks (strict 2% target) point the other way. Long yields rose on the day rather than falling, which is itself inconsistent with a genuinely dovish read -- consistent with markets pricing in inflation-risk premium rather than easier policy.
